lines: A team is not a group of people that work together.
A team is a group of people that <u>trust each other</u>.

caption:
From Together Is Better by Simon Sinek: trust grows when your team knows you’ll say the hard thing kindly, not let it sit and get weird.

Save this for the next talk you’ve been putting off.
